metadata.title: जंगल में एनकाउंटर का सच क्या है | Facts of encounter in Jungle | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: The Sarv Adivasi Samaj has announced a Bastar Bandh on May 28, 2024, in protest against what they describe as fake encounters conducted by security forces. This action follows an incident on May 26, when a fact-finding team from the organization visited Tekameta Village in Kanker district. In this village, 10 individuals were killed by security forces. According to the fact-finding team, four of these individuals were innocent Adivasis, while the remaining six were guerrillas affiliated with the Communist Party of India (Maoist). In contrast, the state police and government maintain that all 10 individuals killed in the encounter were Naxalites. This conflicting account has fueled tensions and led to the call for a bandh to demand justice and accountability for the deaths.
